messages:
Alex: quick heads-up — I pulled the vuln advisory for the kubelet/etcd client libs; looks like an RCE vector in kubelet auth handling and an etcd client deserialization issue. we should triage today and pick a patch window.
Maria: thanks. do we have CVE ids yet or is this vendor advisory-only?
Alex: vendor gave advisory, no public CVE number in feed yet. treating as high-severity until patch validated.
Sam: +1 on triage. recommend: (1) snapshot etcd, (2) carve a canary subset (control-plane + 2 nodes), (3) apply etcd client update, validate leader stability, (4) roll kubelet with drain/uncordon.
Priya: agree. canary specifics: pick low-traffic AZ, pin images by digest, and disable autoscaler for the window. also we need RBAC signoff for cert-manager changes — the cert-manager chart needs clusterrole update in the new build.
Alex: good call. Sam — can you draft the roll order? Priya — can you check cert-manager ClusterRoleDelta and audit log filters so we capture any auth failures post-update?
Sam: draft roll order:
```
1) etcd snapshot: ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl snapshot save /tmp/pre-patch.db --endpoints=https://etcd-0:2379
2) upgrade etcd client pods on controller plane (canary cp1)
3) wait 5m for leader stabilization, check `etcdctl endpoint status` and `kubectl get cs`
4) cordon/drain canary nodes, kubelet upgrade via daemonset restart
```
Will add exact digests.
Priya: for audit logs, add transient rule to forward kube-apiserver audit to long-term S3 path and increase audit-level to RequestResponse for the patch window. also need to ensure KMS key policy allows 'etcd-operator' and 'backup-batch' roles to decrypt snapshots.
Maria: on RBAC — security team needs signoff for ClusterRole changes. @Alex can you own the signoff doc? I'll loop in compliance for the audit retention exception (48h extra).
Alex: I'll own. I'll create a short approval PR in gitops with diff + justification and tag @security-team and @compliance.
DevSecOpsBot: automated reminder — snapshot schedule: next daily snapshot at 02:00 UTC. Will pause snapshot cron for 3 hours during patch window if approved.
Sam: rollback plan: restore etcd snapshot to isolated cluster if leader fails, and roll kubelets back to previous daemonset image via `kubectl set image ds/kubelet -n kube-system kubelet=sha256:<old>` then uncordon. test failover.
Priya: KMS note: if we rotate the key during patch, etcd-operator must be restarted after key rotation. plan to hold rotations 24h before patch.
Alex: timeline proposal: tonight 22:00–23:30 UTC for canary, tomorrow 02:00–05:00 UTC for global. owners: Sam (upgrade runbook), Priya (audit+KMS), Maria (RBAC signoff + compliance), Alex (approvals + communications).
Maria: :thumbsup: I'll prep the RBAC PR and include minimal change set.
Sam: I'll post the runbook link once ready.
Alex: filing issue now and will paste PR/runbook here. thanks all.
